findings.issue: כָּל־בֵּית־יִשְׂרָאֵל is one singular construct house, definite through the name. "toda casa de Israel" is distributive (every household) and multiplies that one house.
לַיְלָה is a noun, not an adverb (unlike יוֹמָם). "de noche" smooths it to a time phrase and closes a predicate reading of תִּהְיֶה לַיְלָה.

notes: Verbless cloud clause, Jehová, 3fs será with fuego, and בו / 3mp viajes match the tokens.
